◆ articulatedActor

DynamicString superdex::prefab::PoseControllerPrefab::articulatedActor {}

Name or hierarchy path of the articulated actor to control.

Note
A name like "myArticulation" refers to an articulated actor in the same prefab. A name like "myPrefab/myArticulation" refers to an articulated actor in a nested prefab.
A referenced actor name must identify exactly one existing actor. Actor names need not be unique, but referencing a name shared by more than one actor, or a name that matches no actor, is invalid and rejected at AddToScene.
